india_context.procedural_notes: Under Section 12A of the Commercial Courts Act 2015, pre-institution mediation is mandatory unless urgent interim relief is prayed for. Commercial contracts exceeding Rs. 3 Lakhs fall within Commercial Division jurisdiction.
